summary: Readiness listeners, early exit/spawn-error handling, bounded SIGTERM-to-SIGKILL waits, and the corrected demo copy check out. Request amendment because close() error/timeout results are ignored by browser-smoke, and an asynchronous ChildProcess error after readiness resolves the exit wait and can skip SIGKILL. A bounded distinct kill-error probe reproduced this with only SIGTERM attempted and no observed exit. No author tests or browser smoke were rerun.
